== Synopsis ==

Once upon a time there were four little Rabbits, and their names were Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton-tail, and Peter. Of these four siblings, three were notably well-behaved. Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail, who were good little bunnies, went down the lane to gather blackberries, pursuing their modest tasks with the virtue expected of them.

Peter, however, was very naughty and did not follow his siblings' example of obedience. While his three brothers and sisters occupied themselves with the wholesome work of gathering blackberries down the lane, Peter ran straight away, abandoning the path of good behavior that his siblings had chosen to follow.

As the tale unfolds, Peter's mischievous nature leads him into difficulty. Presently, Peter sneezed—'Kertyschoo!'—a small sound that would mark a turning point in his adventure, though the full consequences of his naughty behavior and his attempts to navigate the perils that follow remain yet to be revealed.
